messages:
mina: heads up — spotted a weird mismatch between the cost dashboard and the cache savings ledger after yesterday's routing change. looks like 'stitching' requests are getting double-credited as prefetch hits.

devin: ugh. can you paste an example trace id?

mina: sure — trace 0x9a3c in the sample dataset. dashboard shows ~+120 tokens saved (prefetch) but billing shows +0 prefetch credits. payload tags: router=sticky-v2, model=mosaic-4b-q8, stitch_id=stitch-12, cache_hit=true

alejandra: are we conflating "stitching" (server-side assembly of cached prefixes) with prefetch credits? those should be distinct signals: stitch_id implies KV reuse during generation, prefetch_claim implies proactive warm.

sam: right — current telemetry uses cache_hit boolean and origin enum {prefetch, kv_stitch, live}. but the cost attributor uses a heuristic that maps any cache_hit->credit_prefetch unless origin is missing. so missing origin -> assume prefetch.

mina: exactly. origin is often null for stitched requests because the router attaches stitch metadata later in the pipeline.

devin: sounds like an API contract issue between router and attributor. two options: 1) router must attach origin earlier, or 2) attributor should infer from stitch_id presence and not default to prefetch.

gabi: prefer #2 — easier to roll out. Attributor already has logic for stitch_id in other places but not in the new per-token ledger. low-risk fix: add precedence: if stitch_id != null -> credit as kv_stitch.

alejandra: +1. also add a gauge metric: telemetry.tagging.stitch_origin_missing to monitor how often origin is absent. put an alert if >1% of cache_hits in a minute.

sam: can we also correlate with routing policy? sticky-v2 recently started two-phase routing that rewrites requests mid-flight. if router rewrites after tokenization, origin gets lost. that would explain spike.

devin: ok i'll prototype a patch in attributor: prefer stitch_id, then origin enum, then fallback to cache_hit->prefetch. will add the gauge and a small query for the dashboard to show stitch vs prefetch share.

mina: for UX — on the cost dashboard, we should surface a tooltip explaining "stitch credits are internal KV reuse, not prefetch billing credits". teams keep assuming prefetch savings are billable credits.

alejandra: agree. also we should avoid changing historical attribution silently. make the default view 'current attribution' but allow a toggle for 'legacy attribution' for reconciliation.

sam: ops-bot just FYI: deploy-canary for attributor patch on staging scheduled at 15:30 PT.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary started: attributor-v1.8.2-canary — watch /deploy/attributor-canary.

devin: i'll open a short PR with the precedence change + metric + a unit test to detect missing origin edgecases.

mina: thanks — once staging looks green i'll ask data to re-run the 24h batch so we can confirm dashboard vs ledger converge.

gabi: one more ask: add a small field to the per-model econ export: attribution_reason = [stitch,inferred-prefetch,explicit-prefetch,none]. easier for billing reconciliation.

alejandra: works for me. can we put that in the telemetry contract doc? https://redwood.internal/doc/econ-telemetry/contract (edit +1)

devin: will add and ping infra for a canary monitor. ETA for prod rollout ~tomorrow after lunch if no surprises.

mina: thanks everyone. this should clear a bunch of noisy support tickets about "mysterious prefetch savings".
